metadata.title: Temporary Staffing Software Platform Residuality Stress Test
metadata.description: How zvoove's staffing platform must change when labour-leasing law, AI regulation, messaging channels, demand or competition shift.
metadata.naiveArchitecture: Each brand runs its own ERP per country with hard-coded tariffs, one ATS with recruiters phoning applicants, paper or emailed timesheets, payroll and invoicing run from separate exports, and AI features calling a model provider directly from each product.
metadata.residualArchitecture: Versioned, country-specific rule sets evaluated by one engine; placements, hours and pay as events on a shared bus; agents behind one AI gateway with audit logs and human takeover; tenancy with country packs and delegated access for service centres; a governed metrics layer shared by dashboards and the assistant; brand bridges that let products coexist during harmonisation.

stressors.name: The Netherlands requires admission for every lender from 2027
stressors.detection: Wtta publication, ABU/NBBU guidance, customers asking for admission support, client enterprises asking agencies for register proof.
stressors.attractor: Agencies without admission can no longer lease workers and clients may not hire from them; agencies must prove correct wages continuously.
stressors.businessReaction: Add admission status and register checks to clients and subcontractors, generate correct-wage evidence from payroll, and warn before placements with non-admitted chains.
stressors.residue: Admission and certification become versioned attributes of legal entities, checked by the rules engine at placement and invoice time.

impacts.effect: Holds admission rules and register checks.

stressors.name: Recruiting AI is treated as high-risk under the EU AI Act
stressors.detection: AI Act high-risk obligations for employment use cases, works-council requests, customer procurement questionnaires.
stressors.attractor: Every agent that screens or ranks candidates needs risk management, logging, human oversight and transparency to candidates.
stressors.businessReaction: Route all agents through the AI gateway, log every decision, expose explanations and takeover, and publish transparency notices.
stressors.residue: One AI platform with risk classes per use case, evaluation gates and audit logs, instead of per-product model calls.

stressors.name: The messaging platform changes rules or prices for business AI
stressors.detection: Meta policy and pricing announcements for the WhatsApp Business Platform, template rejections, delivery rate drops.
stressors.attractor: Agents that depend on one messaging channel lose reach or become expensive overnight.
stressors.businessReaction: Abstract messaging behind connectors, support SMS, app push and email fallbacks, and keep conversation state channel-independent.
stressors.residue: Channel-neutral conversation state with pluggable connectors.

stressors.name: Industrial demand for temporary workers falls sharply
stressors.detection: Falling hours per customer, fewer active workers on the platform, customers downsizing branches.
stressors.attractor: Revenue tied to active workers or users shrinks while agencies cut costs and question subscriptions.
stressors.businessReaction: Offer managed services and agents that cut agency cost, shift sectors (care, logistics) and price on value delivered.
stressors.residue: Pricing and metrics that do not depend solely on worker volume; services and agents as cost-reduction levers.

impacts.effect: Owner's focus moves from growth to cost.

stressors.name: A global competitor bundles AI agents with large staffing groups
stressors.detection: Partnership announcements, lost enterprise RFPs, pricing pressure.
stressors.attractor: Multi-country groups standardise on a global ATS and ask local ERPs only for payroll and compliance.
stressors.businessReaction: Open APIs so zvoove's compliance, payroll and VMS work with any front office, while the own agents compete on European compliance depth.
stressors.residue: Composable back-office services with public APIs.

stressors.name: Germany mandates equal pay from the first day of an assignment
stressors.detection: Coalition agreements, draft AÜG amendments, association statements.
stressors.attractor: Tariff-based pay differences disappear; pay rates must derive from client comparison pay, which agencies must obtain for every assignment.
stressors.businessReaction: Capture comparable client pay in orders, calculate equal pay per assignment and reprice bill rates.
stressors.residue: Equal-pay reference data as part of the client order and a rules engine that can switch rules by effective date.
